subject: math
title: Хорошие последовательности
statement:
A sequence of real numbers $a_0, a_1, \ldots$ is said to be good if the following three conditions hold.
(i) The value of $a_0$ is a positive integer.
(ii) For each non-negative integer $i$ we have $a_{i+1} = 2a_i + 1$ or $a_{i+1} = \dfrac{a_i}{a_i + 2}$.
(iii) There exists a positive integer $k$ such that $a_k = 2014$.
Find the smallest positive integer $n$ such that there exists a good sequence $a_0, a_1, \ldots$ of real numbers with the property that $a_n = 2014$.
